details.summary: A comprehensive turnkey transformation demanding meticulous spatial planning. Through single-point responsibility, we navigated complex site modifications to deliver a seamless, stress-free interior defined by an exacting attention to detail.

stages.label: Stage 1
stages.title: Raw Site
stages.description: Existing 1,430 sq. ft. flat, stripped back to shell ahead of the renovation scope.

stages.label: Stage 2
stages.title: MEP Routing
stages.description: Plumbing and electrical re-routed to support the new kitchen and bathroom layouts.

stages.label: Stage 3
stages.title: Finish Carpentry
stages.description: Custom wardrobes and kitchen cabinetry installed to the approved material specification.

stages.label: Stage 4
stages.title: Final Handover
stages.description: Sign-off against the original drawing set, three months from Discovery to keys-in-hand.

sections.quote: TactSpaces understood exactly what we wanted and transformed our home beautifully. Their attention to detail, transparency, and commitment throughout the execution made the entire experience smooth and stress-free.
sections.author: Mr. Pinaki
